exit_criteria.statement: The 8 adversary classes are enumerated and each maps to a real, collectable test or an explicit NOT-DEFENDED entry.
The two open adversary gaps (standalone-receipt replay, unpinned policy-version downgrade) have live reproducing tests.
exit_criteria.verify_cmd: uv run --package gove-zone python -m pytest packages/gove-zone/tests/adversary --import-mode=importlib -q

exit_criteria.statement: The build-guard policy loads under the real RuleSetPolicy grammar and denies a catastrophic shell action.

open_findings.note: standalone-receipt replay is NOT-DEFENDED on this branch (no ReceiptConsumptionLedger wired into execute_with_receipt); tracked as a live tripwire in test_standalone_receipt_replay.py.
policy binding is opt-in: a caller that omits expected_policy_hash accepts a downgraded-policy receipt; mitigation (pin expected_policy_hash) is proven in test_policy_version_downgrade.py.

test_results.command: uv run --package gove-zone python -m pytest packages/gove-zone/tests/adversary --import-mode=importlib -q
